fields.DESCRIPTION: Elegant in its simplicity, this handcrafted wooden round platter is a fine example of Rajasthani artistry. Carved from natural wood, it highlights the unique grain patterns and textures that make each piece truly one of a kind. Its flat, wide design makes it perfect for serving snacks, fruits, breads, or cheese platters, and it also doubles up as a stylish base for table décor. With a smooth finish and sturdy build, this platter blends functionality with timeless rustic beauty.
